description: This file contains test utilities for HTTP/2 adapter, including mock classes, data sources, and frame matchers used in testing the quiche HTTP/2 implementation.

classes.name: DataSavingVisitor
classes.description: A mock visitor class that saves data and metadata for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A test data source class that simulates sending data frames.

classes.name: TestMetadataSource
classes.description: A test metadata source class that encodes header entries into frames.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Handles readiness to send data, respecting send limits and errors.

methods.name: OnMetadataForStream
methods.description: Handles incoming metadata for a stream, storing it internally.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stored metadata for a specific stream.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the accumulated data string.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the stored data.

methods.name: set_send_limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for how much data can be sent.

methods.name: is_write_blocked
methods.description: Checks if writing is currently blocked.

methods.name: set_is_write_blocked
methods.description: Sets the write blocked state.

methods.name: set_has_write_error
methods.description: Simulates a write error condition.

methods.name: TestDataFrameSource
methods.description: Simulates a data frame source for testing, with methods to append payloads and end data.

methods.name: AppendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the source.

methods.name: EndData
methods.description: Marks the end of data.

methods.name: SimulateError
methods.description: Simulates an error condition.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length for sending.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a frame with header and payload.

methods.name: send_fin
methods.description: Indicates if the stream should send a FIN.

methods.name: TestMetadataSource
methods.description: Simulates a metadata source for testing header frame encoding.

methods.name: NumFrames
methods.description: Calculates the number of frames needed for the entries.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Encodes header entries into frames.

methods.name: OnFailure
methods.description: Handles failure in encoding.
